prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1098; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim number.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving through the intersection on the main road in Sugar Land, heading east. The light had been green for me as I came up to it.
Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle came from the cross street and hit the driver's side of my car. I didn't see it coming. It was a hard impact, and my car spun partway around.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. I hit my head on the side window and the airbag went off. I've had headaches ever since, and I feel foggy and sensitive to light.
Q: Did you seek medical treatment?
A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the emergency room. They told me I have a concussion and I'm supposed to rest and avoid screens as much as I can.
Q: Are you still experiencing those symptoms?
A: Yes. Some days are better than others, but I still get dizzy and have trouble concentrating at work.
Q: Did you notice whether the other driver stopped or said anything at the scene?
A: The other driver got out and apologized. They said they were looking at their phone and didn't see the light change.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that my car is still at the repair shop, and I'm hoping the claim can be handled quickly so I can get a rental.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
